summary: NbN thin films were deposited using plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) from the precursor Nb(N-t-Bu)(NMeEt)3 (TBTMEN). The process involved optimizing parameters such as plasma pressure, exposure time, and deposition temperature to achieve low-resistivity films with homogeneous thickness. The study demonstrated that PEALD is an effective method for fabricating low-resistivity metallic films at reduced process temperatures, suitable for applications like gate electrodes in CMOS technology.
